name: Promised Land
source:
Main character is an artificial creature who wakes up at a research facility. He has to live with four researchers during one week without knowing anything about himself. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一个在研究设施中醒来的人造生物。他必须与四名研究人员一起生活一周，而对自己一无所知。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
